scope: Bilingual chapter dashboard for the existing Nuovo Espresso Plus 1 and 2 practice

implementation.sourceOfMappings: Existing chapter bank book/chapter/mission metadata; original chapter mission source references; existing four-stage blocks in espresso-plus-a1-a2; existing linked grammar and A2 scene IDs
implementation.loading: Full catalogues are imported only by the dashboard component, which the portal loads lazily. The pure model imports types only.

recorded: Explicit saved route-day completion in the currently selected book programme
separatePracticeEvidence: Cards self-reported remembered in saved sessions
Latest vocabulary game replies, including supported answers
Saved optional gist and changed-story drafts
Latest A2 scene replies, including supported answers
evidenceContract.noInferences: Self-reports, drafts and game answers never complete a lesson, grammar unit or route checkpoint. A1 diagnostics are not presented as A2 assessment. Introductory present-subjunctive scope remains explicit.

progressPreservation.stableIds: Uses the existing twenty bank IDs, twenty mission IDs, ten scene IDs, grammar IDs and eighty route-day indices. No content IDs or saved objects are rewritten.
progressPreservation.recommendation: Traverse unfinished prerequisites before linked grammar, then the core lesson and the existing route. Open the programme page without auto-selecting a programme or jumping its saved day.

sourcePolicy.physicalPages: Exact existing mission references, bounded against source page counts; combined PDF connection offsets are applied only to the opened link.
sourcePolicy.classification: Reader PDF, contents index, teacher support and class source are labelled separately.
sourcePolicy.privateFiles: No raw book text or binaries are added. Source PDFs stay in ignored local folders; links use memory-only connected PDF URLs.

validation.status: Eight focused model tests, focused ESLint, typecheck and diff checks passed. Six isolated browser workflow groups and twelve responsive layout checks passed after root integration.

visualReview.observed: EN and IT 320-pixel next-action cards, the 390-pixel connected-source panel, the desktop overview and the Italian 320-pixel chapter detail were visually inspected. Controls and text fit their containers; book, source-role and recorded-versus-self-report labels remain distinct.

browser.method: Owned disposable headless Chromium with validated synthetic progress; no shared CDP/profile or real learner state.
browser.sandboxException: Existing explicit browser-view allowNoSandbox config used on this root host.

checks.label: Twenty chapters, book filter URL and reload work without replacing the active programme/day
Chapter prerequisite, core, vocabulary and A2 conversation links are exact, focused and programme-preserving
Recorded core/grammar/checkpoint completion stays distinct from full vocabulary reports, supported replies and saved drafts
Actual locally matched combined PDF produces chapter reader links at exact cited physical page +240, with separate teacher-support labels
EN/IT overview and chapter detail fit 320, 390 and 1440 pixel viewports
No runtime errors, external requests or network mutations occurred

limits: Synthetic evidence isolates dashboard behavior; it does not represent a human completion of all chapters.
The existing combined PDF was locally matched for exact link offsets; this does not repeat full PDF export/content verification.
Publisher media and pronunciation were not exercised.
No production site, shared reader, local learner database or backups were accessed.
